title: Picking the wrong GPT-5.6 model is a mistake
description:
OpenAI’s GPT‑5.6 Luna is now 80% cheaper—but Luna, Terra, and Sol are built for different workloads.

See which model wins on high-volume scale, everyday production, and frontier reasoning and coding.

TOKEN PRICES — INPUT / OUTPUT PER 1M TOKENS

• GPT‑5.6 Luna — $0.20 input / $1.20 output
• GPT‑5.6 Terra — $2 input / $12 output
• GPT‑5.6 Sol Standard — $5 input / $30 output
• GPT‑5.6 Sol Fast — $10 input / $60 output

Luna is the fast, affordable choice for high-volume work. Terra balances intelligence and cost for everyday production. Sol targets the hardest reasoning and coding problems, while Fast mode runs up to 2.5× faster with the same intelligence at twice the Standard token price.

These are Standard short-context token rates for AI apps, not consumer subscription prices. Caching and long prompts can change the final bill.

Which would you choose for your AI app: Luna, Terra, or Sol? Share your choice in the comments.
